If contracted at m=0, energised at m=5 (24m -> m=5..28 -> 5 extra months = 5*0.21 = 1.05M)\n# Capital cost: ~0.75%/mo on tied-up cash (or 2%/mo if in debt).\n# Wait: $25M at 0.75%/mo over 24m: interest lost ~ 25 * (1.0075^24 - 1) ~ 25 * 0.196 = $4.9M (minus resale value effect)\n# More precisely, NPV / terminal wealth impact at month 24 of spending $C at m_pay and getting $R at m_24:\n# Each $1 spent at month m reduces final cash at m=24 by (1+r)^(24-m) where r=0.0075 (if cash>=0) or 0.02 (if cash<0).\ndef future_cost(amount, m, r=0.0075):\n    return amount * ((1 + r)**(24 - m))\n\n# Suppose Gen H bought at m=0, delivered at m=3, powered m=3..23 (say using spare or new power at m=3..26 -> 3 extra months)\n# Wait: if bought at m=0, paid at m=0 ($25M).\nc_H_m0 = future_cost(25, 0) - 3.5195 + sum(future_cost(0.21, m) for m in range(3, 27))\nprint(f\"Gen H at m=0 (21 usable mos, us, 3 extra power mos): total m24 cost = ${c_H_m0:.2f}M, per kH-mo = ${c_H_m0/21:.3f}M\")\n\n# Suppose Gen H bought at m=0 in ap (power $0.168/mo, 4 extra mos):\nc_H_ap = future_cost(25, 0) - 3.5195 + sum(future_cost(0.168, m) for m in range(3, 28))\nprint(f\"Gen H at m=0 (21 usable mos, ap, 4 extra power mos): total m24 cost = ${c_H_ap:.2f}M, per kH-mo = ${c_H_ap/21:.3f}M\")\n\n# What if Gen H bought at m=0 from Broker A ($27.5M, arrives m=2, 22 usable mos)?\nc_H_brkA = future_cost(27.5, 0) - 3.5195 + sum(future_cost(0.21, m) for m in range(2, 26))\nprint(f\"Gen H Broker A at m=0 (if delivered, 22 mos, us): total m24 cost = ${c_H_brkA:.2f}M, per kH-mo = ${c_H_brkA/22:.3f}M\")\n\n# What if Gen N bought at m=12 ($40M = $20M/kH, arrives m=15, 9 usable mos m=15..23)?\n# Marked at m=24: 0.75 * 40 * 0.96^12 = 18.381M ($9.19M/kH)\n# Power: 0.8 MW/kH * 0.12 (ap) = 0.096M/mo. If power signed m=11, energised m=15..38 (15 extra mos!)\nc_N_m12_ap = future_cost(20, 12) - 9.1906 + sum(future_cost(0.096, m) for m in range(15, 39))\nprint(f\"Gen N at m=12 (9 usable mos, ap, 15 extra power mos): total m24 cost = ${c_N_m12_ap:.2f}M, per kH-mo = ${c_N_m12_ap/9:.3f}M\")\n# What if Gen N replaces Gen H on existing power (power signed at m=0..2, expires m=26..28, only 3 extra mos, and we resell Gen H)?\nc_N_m12_reuse = future_cost(20, 12) - 9.1906 + sum(future_cost(0.096, m) for m in range(15, 24))\nprint(f\"Gen N at m=12 (9 usable mos, reusing existing power): total m24 cost = ${c_N_m12_reuse:.2f}M, per kH-mo = ${c_N_m12_reuse/9:.3f}M\")\n\n# Compare with Cloud Reservations at m=0 (index=1.6):\n# 6m in ap: 1.6 * 1.15 * 0.95 = 1.748/mo\n# 12m in ap: 1.6 * 1.00 * 0.95 = 1.520/mo\n# 24m in ap: 1.6 * 0.90 * 0.95 = 1.368/mo (24 mos: m=1..24 -> 1 extra month = 1.368 * 24 / 23 = 1.427/mo per usable month!)\n# Wait: if signed at m=0, 12m is m=1..12. At launch (say m=12), index drops 25% -> new 12m after launch would be ~1.20 * 0.95 = 1.14/mo!\n# So 6m or 12m BEFORE launch lets you re-contract AFTER launch at 25% lower price!\n# Wait: 6m at m=0 (m=1..6) costs 1.748/mo. 12m at m=0 (m=1..12) costs 1.520/mo.\n# 24m at m=0 (m=1..24, 23 usable mos) costs 24 * 1.368 / 23 = 1.427/mo!\n# Compare 12m at m=0 (1.520/mo) + 12m at m=12 (say 1.14/mo, {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794690798879,"sessionID":"ses_e241a9365ffeJleIr0ZiERbX5V","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"EO4LuLBOtSeQaWn4","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"python3 -c '\nimport math\n# Prior P(tight m2)=0.90, P(loose m2)=0.10\n# 1. News = loose (0.75 if loose, 0.25 if tight)\n# 2. Index drift = (1.526 - 1.613)/1.613 = -0.0539\n#    loose ~ N(-0.025, 0.05), tight ~ N(0.04, 0.05)\n# 3. Spot/index = 3.74 / 1.526 = 2.451\n#    loose ~ N(1.1, 1.1*0.3=0.33) or lognormal? Wait: even if N(1.1, 0.33), 2.45 is huge!\n#    Wait: what if noise is multiplicative 30% std on log or uniform [0.7, 1.3]?\n#    Let us check normal std=0.3*mean:\ndef norm_pdf(x, mu, sig):\n    return math.exp(-0.5*((x-mu)/sig)**2) / sig\n\np_t = 0.90 * 0.25 * norm_pdf(-0.0539, 0.04, 0.05) * norm_pdf(2.451, 1.8, 1.8*0.3)\np_l = 0.10 * 0.75 * norm_pdf(-0.0539, -0.025, 0.05) * norm_pdf(2.451, 1.1, 1.1*0.3)\nprint(\"Normal spot noise -> P(tight):\", p_t/(p_t+p_l), \"P(loose):\", p_l/(p_t+p_l))\n# Wait: what if spot noise has heavy tail or is uniform/normal with larger sigma?\n# Either way, we can check directly by reserving in ap!\n'"},"output":"Normal spot noise -> P(tight): 0.9987246055732061 P(loose): 0.0012753944267939158\n","metadata":{"output":"Normal spot noise -> P(tight): 0.9987246055732061 P(loose): 0.0012753944267939158\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"python3 -c '\nimport math\n# Prior P(tight m2)=0.90, P(loose m2)=0.10\n# 1. Spot/index = 3.74 / 1.526 = 2.451\n#    loose ~ N(1.1, 1.1*0.3=0.33) or lognormal? Wait: even if N(1.1, 0.33), 2.45 is huge!\n#    Wait: what if noise is multiplicative 30% std on log or uniform [0.7, 1.3]?\n#    Let us check normal std=0.3*mean:\ndef norm_pdf(x, mu, sig):\n    return math.exp(-0.5*((x-mu)/sig)**2) / sig\n\np_t = 0.90 * 0.25 * norm_pdf(-0.0539, 0.04, 0.05) * norm_pdf(2.451, 1.8, 1.8*0.3)\np_l = 0.10 * 0.75 * norm_pdf(-0.0539, -0.025, 0.05) * norm_pdf(2.451, 1.1, 1.1*0.3)\nprint(\"Normal spot noise -> P(tight):\", p_t/(p_t+p_l), \"P(loose):\", p_l/(p_t+p_l))\n# Wait: what if spot noise has heavy tail or is uniform/normal with larger sigma?\n# Either way, we can check directly by reserving in ap!\n'","time":{"start":1794690798822,"end":1794690798867}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dbe854de001PJGGBRnXAfp8XF","sessionID":"ses_e241a9365ffeJleIr0ZiERbX5V","messageID":"msg_1dbe83ab3001Z31POLOWg1dZij"}}

(Notice: used value is 40 * 0.96^(months since launch), launch=13, so at m24 it is ALWAYS 0.96^11 = 9.575M/kH regardless of when ordered!!)\n# Wait: check rule: \"gen N $40M x 0.96^(months since launch)\"!\n# Yes! At m24 (11 months since launch at m13), 75% mark = 0.75 * 20 * 0.96^11 = $9.575M/kH!\nmark_m24 = 0.75 * 20 * (0.96**11)\nprint(f\"Gen N m24 mark per kH = ${mark_m24:.3f}M (regardless of order month!)\")\n\nfor m_ord in [13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18]:\n    m_arr = m_ord + 3\n    usable = 24 - m_arr\n    if usable <= 0: continue\n    # Power in ap ($0.096/mo for 24 mos, say starting at m_arr -> 24 mos):\n    # Wait: if we already contracted ap power (e.g. 18.2 MW spare at m14) + us power (16 MW spare at m14),\n    # that power is ALREADY SUNK if not used! Wait: we should check BOTH with new power AND with sunk power!\n    c_no_pwr = fc(20, m_ord) - mark_m24\n    c_with_ap_pwr = c_no_pwr + sum(fc(0.096, m) for m in range(m_arr, m_arr+24))\n    print(f\"Order m{m_ord} -> arrive m{m_arr} ({usable} usable mos): no_new_pwr=${c_no_pwr/usable:.3f}M/mo | with_new_ap_pwr=${c_with_ap_pwr/usable:.3f}M/mo\")\n\n# Compare with Capacity Options exercised for 6 mos at m15 (m16..21) or m17 (m18..23):\n# $1M upfront + $1.6M/mo * 6 mos (all within m16..23 -> ZERO wasted tail!):\nc_opt_15 = fc(1.0, 15) + sum(fc(1.6, m) for m in range(16, 22))\nc_opt_17 = fc(1.0, 17) + sum(fc(1.6, m) for m in range(18, 24))\nprint(f\"Option exercised m15 (m16..21, 6 mos): ${c_opt_15/6:.3f}M/mo (m24 value)\")\nprint(f\"Option exercised m17 (m18..23, 6 mos): ${c_opt_17/6:.3f}M/mo (m24 value)\")\n'"},"output":"Gen N m24 mark per kH = $9.574M (regardless of order month!)\nOrder m13 -> arrive m16 (8 usable mos): no_new_pwr=$1.517M/mo | m_order (arriving at m_arr, usable m_arr..23)\n# Suppose we pay $20M/kH at m_order.\n# Marked at m24 = 0.75 * 20 * 0.96^(24-13) = $9.575M/kH! (Notice: used value is 40 * 0.96^(months since launch), launch=13, so at m24 it is ALWAYS 0.96^11 = 9.575M/kH regardless of when ordered!!)\n# Wait: check rule: \"gen N $40M x 0.96^(months since launch)\"!\n# Yes! At m24 (11 months since launch at m13), 75% mark = 0.75 * 20 * 0.96^11 = $9.575M/kH!\nmark_m24 = 0.75 * 20 * (0.96**11)\nprint(f\"Gen N m24 mark per kH = ${mark_m24:.3f}M (regardless of order month!)\")\n\nfor m_ord in [13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18]:\n    m_arr = m_ord + 3\n    usable = 24 - m_arr\n    if usable <= 0: continue\n    # Power in ap ($0.096/mo for 24 mos, say starting at m_arr -> 24 mos):\n    # Wait: if we already contracted ap power (e.g. 18.2 MW spare at m14) + us power (16 MW spare at m14),\n    # that power is ALREADY SUNK if not used! Wait: we should check BOTH with new power AND with sunk power!\n    c_no_pwr = fc(20, m_ord) - mark_m24\n    c_with_ap_pwr = c_no_pwr + sum(fc(0.096, m) for m in range(m_arr, m_arr+24))\n    print(f\"Order m{m_ord} -> arrive m{m_arr} ({usable} usable mos): no_new_pwr=${c_no_pwr/usable:.3f}M/mo | with_new_ap_pwr=${c_with_ap_pwr/usable:.3f}M/mo\")\n\n# Compare with Capacity Options exercised for 6 mos at m15 (m16..21) or m17 (m18..23):\n# $1M upfront + $1.6M/mo * 6 mos (all within m16..23 -> ZERO wasted tail!):\nc_opt_15 = fc(1.0, 15) + sum(fc(1.6, m) for m in range(16, 22))\nc_opt_17 = fc(1.0, 17) + sum(fc(1.6, m) for m in range(18, 24))\nprint(f\"Option exercised m15 (m16..21, 6 mos): ${c_opt_15/6:.3f}M/mo (m24 value)\")\nprint(f\"Option exercised m17 (m18..23, 6 mos): ${c_opt_17/6:.3f}M/mo (m24 value)\")\n'","time":{"start":1794690998386,"end":1794690998468}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dbeb6051001AcoYq91x2QVB1E","sessionID":"ses_e241a9365ffeJleIr0ZiERbX5V","messageID":"msg_1dbeb3789001JUM7g251UF4Njp"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794691110581,"sessionID":"ses_e241a9365ffeJleIr0ZiERbX5V","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"dm8EC59ixT9MZhZv","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"python3 -c '\nimport math\nobs = [6.64, 6.27, 7.13, 7.55, 8.43, 8.32, 9.31, 11.73, 10.83, 12.67, 12.63, 14.76, 15.60, 17.35, 19.93, 18.18, 20.84]\n# Compare likelihood of 8% constant vs switch to 4% at m_sw in 8..15:\n# Model d_m = d0 * prod_{t=0..m-1}(1+g_t) * eps, eps ~ N(1, 0.05)\ndef best_ll(gs):\n    # grid or closed form d0\n    prod = [1.0]\n    for g in gs: prod.append(prod[-1]*(1+g))\n    # MLE d0:\n    d0 = sum(o/p for o, p in zip(obs, prod)) / len(obs)\n    ll = sum(-0.5 * ((o - d0*p)/(0.05*d0*p))**2 for o, p in zip(obs, prod))\n    return ll, d0\n\nll_8, d0_8 = best_ll([0.08]*16)\nprint(f\"8% constant: d0={d0_8:.3f}, ll={ll_8:.2f}, pred_m16={d0_8*1.08**16:.2f}\")\nfor m_sw in range(8, 16):\n    gs = [0.08 if m < m_sw else 0.04 for m in range(16)]\n    ll, d0 = best_ll(gs)\n    print(f\"Switch to 4% at m={m_sw}: d0={d0:.3f}, ll={ll:.2f}, pred_m16={d0*math.prod(1+g for g in gs):.2f}\")\n\n# Now compute remaining Run 3 training needed after m16:\n# Done = 34.19, needed = 320 -> remaining for m17..23 = 285.81 kH-mo!\n# Committed capacity in m17..23 BEFORE new m17 options (assuming we move 4k H eu->ap at m19!):\n# m17: us=7.14+7, eu=4.0+4, ap=9.86+12+10 -> total = 54.00\n# m18: us=7.14+7, eu=4.0+4, ap=9.86+12+10 -> total = 54.00\n# m19: us=7.14+6, eu=4.0+4, ap=9.86+12+10 -> total = 53.00 (remember 4k H in eu moves at END of m19 or during m19?\n# WAIT!! RULE CHECK: \"move_gpus: they are out of service for the rest of this month and arrive for next month.\"\n# THAT MEANS if we move 4k H from eu->ap in m19, they are OUT OF SERVICE for m19!!\n# Whereas if we move them at m19, we lose 4.00 kH in m19 (paying $2M + losing 4 kH-mo)!\n# Compare: if we DON'T move them, we lose 4.00 kH * 4 mos (m20..23) = 16 kH-mo!\n# If we DO move them in m19, we lose 4 kH in m19, gain 4*4=16 kH in m20..23 -> net +12 kH-mo for $2M = $0.167M/kH-mo!!\n# WAIT: EVEN BETTER!! If we move 2k in m19? No, we have 4k in eu whose power expires at END of m19 (so in m20..23 it has 0 MW!).
